name: gleif
title: GLEIF — Legal Entity Identifiers
description: The Global Legal Entity Identifier Foundation's public register of legal entities — every entity with its 20-character LEI, legal name, country, jurisdiction and registration status.

lei.description: The 20-character ISO 17442 Legal Entity Identifier — the entity's globally unique key in the GLEIF register.

legal_name.description: The entity's official legal name, as recorded in the GLEIF golden copy. The bounds are the register's own: LEI-CDF v3.1 types this element NameType, a complexType whose simpleContent extends Tokenized500Type — the extension adds an optional xml:lang attribute and leaves the inherited value space, which restricts the text to between 1 and 500 characters. Names at both ends are genuine — single-character names are registered in several jurisdictions, and names past 200 characters are typically a registry's full form, such as the Italian convention of carrying the permitted trading abbreviations inside the registered name.

country.description: Country of the entity's legal address, as the GLEIF register records it. The register types this element as a two-letter country code (LEI-CDF v3.1's CountryCodeType), and the pattern here is that shape. It checks shape, not assignment: the schema itself notes that a well-formed pair of upper-case letters need not be a valid ISO 3166 entry, and values outside the ISO-assigned list do occur in this column, so treat membership of an ISO reference list as something to verify rather than assume.

city.description: City of the entity's legal address.

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction the entity is constituted under, as the GLEIF register records it. The register types this element as a country code or a country-plus-subdivision code — LEI-CDF v3.1's JurisdictionCodeType, a union of its CountryCodeType and RegionCodeType — and the pattern here is the union of those two shapes. It checks shape, not assignment: the schema itself notes that a well-formed value need not be a valid ISO 3166 entry, and values outside the ISO-assigned lists do occur in this column, so treat membership of an ISO reference list as something to verify rather than assume.

legal_form.description: ELF (Entity Legal Form) code classifying the entity's legal form.

entity_status.description: The register's entity status, as text: ACTIVE (legally registered and operating as of the last report), INACTIVE (no longer legally registered or operating), or the four-character string NULL, which the register uses to mean the status is not applicable. These three are LEI-CDF v3.1's EntityStatusEnum. It is not a boolean, and the string NULL is a reported value rather than a missing one — the field is declared required so that an actual SQL null reads as a violation instead of as a synonym for that value.

registration_status.description: LEI registration lifecycle status (e.g. ISSUED, LAPSED, RETIRED).

initial_registration.description: Date the LEI was first registered (calendar date sliced from the golden-copy timestamp).

next_renewal.description: Date the LEI registration is next due for renewal.

corpus.description: Lowercased, accent-stripped concatenation of legal name + city + country — a derived free-text search field, not a source attribute.
